001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.econ;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.Map;
006
007import java.awt.Color;
008
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.CommodityOnMarketAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketConditionAPI;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableStat.StatMod;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableStatWithTempMods;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Conditions;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.CountingMap;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
019
020public class ShippingDisruption extends BaseMarketConditionPlugin {
021        
022        public static String COMMODITY_LOSS_PREFIX = "sh_loss";
023        public static float ACCESS_LOSS_DURATION = 120f;
024        
025        public static float ACCESS_PER_UNITS_LOST = 0.1f; // accessibility penalty per marketSize units lost
026        
027        
028        public static float getPenaltyForShippingLost(float marketSize, float unitsLost) {
029                float result = Math.round(unitsLost / marketSize * ACCESS_PER_UNITS_LOST  * 100f) / 100f;
030                if (result == 0) result = 0.01f;
031                return result;
032        }
033        
034        public static ShippingDisruption getDisruption(MarketAPI market) {
035                MarketConditionAPI mc = market.getCondition(Conditions.SHIPPING_DISRUPTION);
036                if (mc == null) {
037                        String id = market.addCondition(Conditions.SHIPPING_DISRUPTION);
038                        mc = market.getSpecificCondition(id);
039                        //mc.setFromEvent(true);
040                }
041                return (ShippingDisruption) mc.getPlugin();
042        }
043        
044        protected MutableStatWithTempMods shippingLost = new MutableStatWithTempMods(0f); 
045        
046        protected float disruptionTimeLeft = 0f;
047        public ShippingDisruption() {
048        }
049        
050        /**
051         * "units" is the largest number of econ-units of a commodity being carried by a trade fleet. 
052         * For example, 5 food, 3 organics, 2 fuel = 5 units = approximate "size" of that trade fleet, in economy terms.
053         * @param units
054         */
055        public void addShippingLost(float units) {
056                shippingLost.addTemporaryModFlat(ACCESS_LOSS_DURATION, getModId() + Misc.genUID(), units);
057                updatePenaltyValue();
058        }
059
060        protected void updatePenaltyValue() {
061                unapply(getModId());
062                apply(getModId());
063        }
064
065        public float getDisruptionTimeLeft() {
066                return disruptionTimeLeft;
067        }
068
069        public void setDisruptionTimeLeft(float disruptionTimeLeft) {
070                this.disruptionTimeLeft = disruptionTimeLeft;
071        }
072
073        public void notifyDisrupted(float duration) {
074                disruptionTimeLeft = Math.max(disruptionTimeLeft, duration);
075        }
076        public void apply(String id) {
077                float penalty = getPenaltyForShippingLost(market.getSize(), shippingLost.getModifiedValue());
078                String name = "Trade fleets lost";
079                market.getAccessibilityMod().modifyFlat(id, -penalty, name);
080                
081                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
082                        for (CommodityOnMarketAPI com : market.getCommoditiesCopy()) {
083                                List<String> unmodify = new ArrayList<String>();
084                                if (com.getMaxSupply() >= com.getAvailable() + 1) {
085                                        for (String key : com.getAvailableStat().getFlatMods().keySet()) {
086                                                StatMod mod = com.getAvailableStat().getFlatStatMod(key);
087                                                int val = (int)Math.round(Math.abs(mod.value));
088                                                if (key.startsWith(COMMODITY_LOSS_PREFIX) && val != 0) {
089                                                        unmodify.add(mod.source);
090                                                }
091                                        }
092                                }
093                                for (String modId : unmodify) {
094                                        com.getAvailableStat().unmodifyFlat(modId);
095                                }
096                        }
097                }
098        }
099
100        public void unapply(String id) {
101                market.getAccessibilityMod().unmodifyFlat(id);
102        }
103        
104        
105        @Override
106        public void advance(float amount) {
107                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
108                shippingLost.advance(days);
109                updatePenaltyValue();
110                
111                disruptionTimeLeft -= days;
112                if (disruptionTimeLeft <= 0) {
113                        disruptionTimeLeft = 0;
114                        if (shippingLost.isUnmodified()) {
115                                market.removeSpecificCondition(condition.getIdForPluginModifications());
116                        }
117                }
118        }
119
120        public Map<String, String> getTokenReplacements() {
121                return super.getTokenReplacements();
122                //return event.getTokenReplacements();
123        }
124
125        @Override
126        public String[] getHighlights() {
127                return super.getHighlights();
128                //return event.getHighlights("report_td");
129        }
130        
131        @Override
132        public boolean isTransient() {
133                return false;
134        }
135
136        @Override
137        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded) {
138                tooltip.addTitle("Shipping Disruption");
139                
140                int loss = shippingLost.getModifiedInt();
141                
142                int penalty = (int)Math.round(getPenaltyForShippingLost(market.getSize(), shippingLost.getModifiedValue()) * 100f);
143                
144                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
145                Color n = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
146                
147                float pad = 3f;
148                float small = 5f;
149                float opad = 10f;
150                
151                //tooltip.addPara("Loss: %s, Accesibility penalty: %s", pad, h, "" + loss, "" + penalty);
152                if (penalty > 0) {
153                        tooltip.addPara("Trade fleets launched from " + market.getName() + " have suffered losses, " +
154                                        "resulting in a temporary accessibility penalty of %s.", opad, h, "" + penalty + "%");
155                }
156                
157                CountingMap<CommodityOnMarketAPI> losses = new CountingMap<CommodityOnMarketAPI>();
158                
159                for (CommodityOnMarketAPI com : market.getCommoditiesCopy()) {
160                        for (String key : com.getAvailableStat().getFlatMods().keySet()) {
161                                StatMod mod = com.getAvailableStat().getFlatStatMod(key);
162                                
163                                int val = (int)Math.round(Math.abs(mod.value));
164                                if (key.startsWith(COMMODITY_LOSS_PREFIX) && val != 0) {
165                                        losses.add(com, val); 
166                                }
167                        }
168                }
169                
170                if (!losses.isEmpty()) {
171                        tooltip.addPara("The local availability of some commodities has been reduced by trade fleet losses. " +
172                                        "Provided no further losses occur, commodity availability should return to normal levels within at most three months.", opad);
173                        tooltip.beginGridFlipped(400, 1, 30, opad);
174                        int j = 0;
175                        for (CommodityOnMarketAPI com : losses.keySet()) {
176                                tooltip.addToGrid(0, j++, com.getCommodity().getName(), 
177                                                                                "-" + losses.getCount(com), h);
178                        }
179                        tooltip.addGrid(pad);
180                }
181                
182                //tooltip.addPara(com.getCommodity().getName() + ": %s", pad, h, "" + (int) mod.value);
183        }
184
185        @Override
186        public float getTooltipWidth() {
187                return super.getTooltipWidth();
188        }
189
190        @Override
191        public boolean hasCustomTooltip() {
192                return true;
193        }
194
195        @Override
196        public boolean isTooltipExpandable() {
197                return super.isTooltipExpandable();
198        }
199        
200
201}
